artworks.title: Profile of an Old Man with a Beard
artworks.description: The image shows the head and shoulders of a person in profile, facing left. The person is wearing a large hood that partially covers their head. They have a pronounced nose and a long beard extending down their chest. The person's expression is not visible. They are not wearing any visible clothing, and there are no visible objects around them. The background is a textured surface with a stippling pattern.

artworks.title: The Miracle of the Lame Man Healed by Saint Peter and Saint John
artworks.artist: Sir Peter Paul Rubens over Anonymous Italian after Parmigianino after Raphael
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened in buff, on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: Drawn with brown ink and shaded with brown wash, a crowd gathers in a columned space on this horizontal sheet. Two columns divide the scene into thirds. The column on the left is straight, and the column on the right twists, as if gently rippling in an elongated spiral. A row of four more columns behind each of these front columns mimics their contours. Between the two front columns and close to us, a clean-shaven man and a bearded man look down at a man who sits with one ankle crossed over the other knee. The seated man looks up with his mouth open, the corners downturned, and his brows furrowed. The bearded man holds one hand up, palm facing out, and the clean-shaven man looks down with one hand reaching forward, palm up. Three more faces between the clean-shaven man and the twisting column look on, and one of them crosses his hands over the top of a crutch or walking stick. Three more people press close to the group on the right side of the twisting column. One nude, pudgy child holds onto one of the onlooker’s robes, and another nude child stands next to a woman along the right side of the sheet. The woman looks over her shoulder at us and appears to balance or brace a tray on her head. A bird is painted in slate blue on the tray. The child braces a stick across one shoulder, and two birds hang at the ends of strings on the back end. Five people stand, including a woman holding a baby, to the left of the straight column and a sixth person kneels and leans against a staff. More rows of straight columns line either side of the sheet.

artworks.title: Auditus (Hearing)
artworks.artist: Cornelis Cort after Frans Floris I
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lute player sitting under a tree with a deer. The image depicts a detailed interaction between nature and music. To the left, a large deer is resting on the ground. The figure is playing a lute, surrounded by musical instruments and literature. Engraved text is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Gustus (Taste)
artworks.artist: Cornelis Cort after Frans Floris I
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on the ground. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the right, leaning forward with an elbow resting on a wicker basket while holding a knife and a piece of fruit. The person has classical stylized features, with their hair mostly covered. They are wearing a long-sleeved garment that extends to the ankles and there are no visible pieces of jewelry. Around the figure are elements like a large wicker basket overflowing with fruits and a small monkey on the right side interacting with a pear. In the background, there are detailed trees with thick trunks and leafy branches. The setting suggests an outdoor environment, with a stone surface and a metal goblet on a small pedestal placed nearby. The image is characterized by intricate linework, indicative of an engraving.

artworks.title: Odoratus (Smell)
artworks.artist: Cornelis Cort after Frans Floris I
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.5 x 26.9 cm (8 1/16 x 10 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman with a dog in a garden. The woman is arranging flowers in a vase, with a potted plant in a trellis to the left and a tree to the right. In the background, there are rolling hills and a small village. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatching technique.

artworks.title: Tactus (Touch)
artworks.artist: Cornelis Cort after Frans Floris I
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure interacting with nature. The image depicts a seated personification, draped in flowing fabric, holding a bird on an outstretched hand next to a body of water. To the right, a small boat rests on the shore with a few tall grasses growing nearby. At the bottom right, a turtle crawls towards the figure. In the background, a spider web is visible in the upper left, stretching between branches.

artworks.title: Visus (Sight)
artworks.artist: Cornelis Cort after Frans Floris I
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated figure holding a mirror to their face with one hand while the other hand rests in their lap. The figure has classical facial features, curly hair with a laurel wreath, and is dressed in draped clothing. They are seated against a column with a large bird next to them. The background includes a landscape with water, architectural structures, trees, and hills under a sunlit sky. A sun with rays is above the figure's head, and there is a small winged figure to the left of the column.

artworks.title: Battle of the Horatii and the Curiatii
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 31.2 x 40.6 cm (12 5/16 x 16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient battle scene. The full-description of this drawing features a group of armed warriors engaged in combat, with weapons drawn and shields raised in a Roman-like arena. Onlookers line the sides, tents and military encampments are visible in the background. The drawing showcases intricate detailing in armor, musculature, and facial expressions, depicting movement and tension in the confrontation.

artworks.title: Isabella d'Este
artworks.artist: Pieter Holsteyn II, after Giulio Romano
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated and facing forward. Her head is upright, with her gaze directed slightly to the side. She has a round face shape with defined facial features, and her hair is styled into an intricately detailed updo, adorned with a flower accessory. The woman is wearing a dress with elaborate lace or embroidered patterns, featuring puffed sleeves and detailed cuffs. Draped around her neck are long, ornate chains, one of which is holding a string of beads with various shapes. Her hands rest in her lap, showing a ring on one of her fingers. In the background, there is a scene depicting a woman pulling back a curtain to reveal other figures, set within a framed architectural space.

artworks.title: Philip IV (Philippe IV)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing outdoors. He is slightly turned to his right, with one arm resting on a walking stick or staff. The man has a pointed mustache and moderate-length hair parted at the side. He is wearing a tunic with an ornate collar, detailed sleeves, and knee-high boots. A dog sits next to him. In the background, there is a dense tree with foliage. The ground beneath them is roughly sketched.

artworks.title: Concert with Nine Persons
artworks.description: The image shows a group of eight individuals in a classical setting, engaged in music and conversation. The central figure, a woman with long braided hair, is holding a violin. Another woman is seated on the floor playing the lute, and several men are seated or leaning in, paying attention. A couple is seated on the right, and the background includes a draped curtain, a solid column, and a table with sheet music or papers.

artworks.title: Two Nymphs and a Satyr
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts mythological figures in a nature setting. The lines are fluid and expressive, capturing dynamic interactions. The background features sketchy renderings of trees and foliage. The figures have elongated forms and the composition is energetic and somewhat dramatic. The use of ink lines and lack of color lends a classic and timeless quality to the image.

artworks.title: Villa di Papa Giulio
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a classical building, focusing on architectural details like arches and pilasters. The perspective captures the left side of the building with the horizon aligning with the rooftop. The drawing uses delicate ink wash brushstrokes in soft tans and grays. The landscape includes trees and shrubs, with a clear sky and a few wispy clouds.

artworks.title: The Emperor Aulus Vitellius
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a standing man. He is shown with one leg bent and the other extended, with his left hand across his chest and his right hand holding a scroll. The man has a rounded face with a prominent chin, high forehead, short curly hair, and wears a flowing garment. The background features a stone-like architectural frame with columns or decorative elements and an inscription in the top right corner that reads, "A-VITELLIVS. GERMAN. IMP. AVG.P.M.TR."

artworks.title: A Striding Youth with His Arms Raised, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a human figure seen from the back, spanning from head to feet. The person is in a dynamic pose with one arm raised and bent at the elbow, and the other arm extended downward. The facial features are not detailed, with the head shown in profile from behind. The figure's hair is loosely suggested, and there are no clothing details, accessories, or objects present. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure's linework.

artworks.title: Cristi... v'la-t-y un boeuf qui est bien fait!...
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals standing closely together, facing the right. In the foreground, there are five men wearing top hats, with distinct facial features and various expressions. They are dressed in suits and coats typical of the era. Behind them is a woman with a scarf covering her head and a shawl over a patterned dress. The background features framed pictures, creating depth in the setting, suggesting an art gallery or exhibition space.

artworks.title: Horseman and Vagabond in the Forest (Le Cavalier en forêt et le piéton)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a path leading through dense foliage. The horizon is obscured, creating depth. The foliage is etched with intricate details, suggesting trees. The path is lined with sketch-like brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic in dark gray and off-white tones. Two figures and a horse are subtly included, blending into the landscape. The scene appears complex with movement and shadows.

artworks.title: Château de Pont-Gibaud
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic village scene with old buildings, a castle on the horizon, a elevated view with architectural and landscape details depicted through intricate brushstrokes. The color palette is predominantly gray, with a monochromatic theme. A patch of water, vegetation, buildings, and a castle in the distance can be seen, under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with light brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several abstracted figures in different poses. Two seated figures on the left, with one holding an ambiguous object. Three standing figures on the right, depicted in an abstract manner. The lines are fluid and expressive, using red and dark ink to define shapes and shadows.

artworks.title: Louis de France, duc de Bourgogne
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person within an ornate oval frame. The person has long, curly hair and a composed facial expression. They are wearing a suit of armor with intricate detailing, and there is a plumed helmet in the foreground. A fabric sash is draped across their chest. A rich, flowing fabric is below the helmet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Auguste-Jean-Marie Guénepin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of the upper half of a person in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. The individual has distinct facial features, such as a broad face with defined cheekbones and a slight smile. They have curly, voluminous hair framing their face and are dressed in a buttoned-up garment with a high collar, reminiscent of historical clerical or academic attire. The person is holding a book with both hands in front of them, suggesting a sense of contemplation or study. In the background, there is an architectural element resembling a classical building facade, possibly indicating an outdoor or city setting. The drawing is done in pencil, giving it a detailed and precise appearance.

artworks.title: L'ane et le chien (The Donkey and the Dog)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a donkey with baskets, a dog interacting with it, a person resting, a stone bridge over a river, buildings, mountains, and cloudy sky in a serene, pastoral scene. The artwork features detailed brushwork and etching-like textures with muted earth tones and pastel colors.

artworks.title: Les deux rats, le renard et l'oeuf (Two Rats, the Fox, and the Egg)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with a stone structure, a forest, and animals. The image shows a natural landscape with a stone monument or fountain on the left, surrounded by trees. In the center, two rats are carrying an egg, and a fox is standing on the right. The illustration features detailed cross-hatching and line work depicting textures in the stones, foliage, and animal fur.

artworks.title: La chauve-souris, le buisson et le canard (The Bat, the Bush, and the Duck)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a duck on sandy ground, a tree on the left, and a flying bat in the sky. The sky is dynamic and the ocean waves are visible.
